oliver: @here quick alert  since 04:12 UTC we're seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures from the edge proxy to backend agents in ap-south-1. Affected services: hosted-api (ingress -> proxy) and private-agent egress to some customer endpoints. Customers might have seen 502s or connection resets. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2449990000

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027-210 created  severity: high  services: edge-proxy, hosted-api, private-agent  start: 2027-03-28T04:12:10Z

jamie: quick timeline: 04:07 small config push to edge-proxy deploying new client-cert rotation logic -> 04:10 edge proxies began returning TLS alert 40/handshake_failure -> 04:12 automated health check flips routed traffic to backup region -> 04:15 rollback of the client-cert change started. Impact window ~04:07-04:15 UTC but some replays hit timeouts.

maya: mitigation steps: 1) rolled back client-cert rotation at 04:15 2) forced re-establish of proxy TLS sessions and disabled session resumption for ap-south pool 3) rotated expired intermediate cert on one affected egress host that had a bad chain. Connection success rate trending up.

eng-oncall: commands we ran / logs: ```kubectl -n edge logs -l app=edge-proxy --since=20m | grep "tls alert"``` and ```openssl s_client -connect backend.example.internal:443 -showcerts -servername backend.example.internal```  verified cert chain mismatch on host edge-proxy-3. Replaced cert and restarted pod.

jamie: temporary safeguards: 1) disable automated cert rotation job for 1h 2) add preflight cert-chain validation to rotation pipeline 3) added a synthetic probe that performs full handshake and validation prior to cutover.

cs-team: customer comms: banner posted 04:22 UTC. Draft: "We experienced brief TLS handshake failures for API requests served from ap-south-1 between ~04:07-04:20 UTC. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity and most requests succeeded. If you continue to see errors, please contact support and reference INC-2027-210."

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated  monitoring  link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2449990000  postmortem: scheduled 2027-03-29T15:00Z

oliver: thanks all  please paste any logs and the exact cert expiry that triggered this into the postmortem doc. If you see regressions reopen this thread or ping me directly. :lock:
